sources.location: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/pride/ws/archive/v2/projects/PXD040461/files?pageSize=100&page=0 (13 files: 10 RAW, summary.txt, proteinGroups.txt; page 1 empty)
doi:10.1128/aem.01510-23, PMID 38095456, PMC10807428 (abstract only; full text not open access, Europe PMC fullTextXML returns HTTP 500)

claims.evidence: PRIDE organism NEWT:305959 and organism part BTO:0002690 biofilm; protocol: colonies grown on agar and scraped; paper abstract: biofilm-adapted wrinkly colony mutant of X. retroflexus

claims.value: A-D = experiment D3_A..D3_D (bio rep 1-4); E-I = D3w_A..D3w_E (bio rep 1-5); H_techrep and I_techrep = technical replicate 2 of D3w_D and D3w_E
claims.evidence: summary.txt Raw file -> Experiment table (H and H_techrep both D3w_D; I and I_techrep both D3w_E)

claims.value: D3 = wild type; D3w = wrinkly colony variant
claims.evidence: PRIDE protocol compares sample groups 'wrinkled and wildtype'; paper abstract XRw vs wild type; experiment prefix D3 vs D3w from summary.txt. The w = wrinkly assignment is an inference from the prefix (see limitations)
RAW headers of all 10 files: Q Exactive - Orbitrap MS; HCD from PRIDE protocol and the RAW method (Fragmentation_HCD)
PRIDE protocol 'trypsin (1:100)'; summary.txt Enzyme is Trypsin/P; the record's wording was used

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M, Acetyl protein N-term variable; precursor 4.5 ppm, fragment 20 ppm
claims.evidence: summary.txt variable modifications; PRIDE data processing protocol (fixed carbamidomethyl, tolerances)
PRIDE protocol: reduced with 5 mM DTT, alkylated with 20 mM iodoacetamide
protocol: data recorded in a data dependent manner; term resolved against live OLS4

RAW embedded instrument method (reviewer read first 8 MB of all 10 files): Fragmentation_HCD EnergyType=normalized 25 in the MS2 scan event; scan headers read nce: 25. PRIDE protocol text says 28%, which conflicts; raw takes precedence

claims.value: Method matches protocol on Top10, isolation window 1.6, resolutions 70000/17500 and 130 min gradient; differs on scan ranges
claims.evidence: RAW method MS1 300-1750 and MS2 200-2000 m/z; protocol says 350-1500. Scan ranges are not annotated

limitations: Paper full text not accessible (not open access; Europe PMC fullTextXML HTTP 500, PMC pages blocked); only the abstract and the PRIDE protocols were read, so the strain designation behind D3 / D3w is not documented in anything read

Phenotype wild type for D3 and wrinkly colony variant for D3w is inferred from the deposited experiment names plus the protocol's 'wrinkled and wildtype' groups; no deposited file states the mapping explicitly
Biological replicate numbers follow the letters A-E in summary.txt experiment names; no file describes them as independent cultures
Deposited summary.txt and proteinGroups.txt also list D3inter_A..E (RAW files J-N), which are not in the PRIDE deposit and are not annotated

Cleavage agent written as Trypsin (record wording); the deposited search used Trypsin/P; sdrf-tools reconcile still raises cleavage_agent_unsupported although the PRIDE protocol names trypsin (false positive)
Strain, genotype, disease and growth temperature columns omitted or not annotated: no strain name read; disease not applicable not asserted
Runs are unfractionated (fraction identifier 1 by default) per the protocol, which describes no fractionation
characteristics[phenotype] is not in the ms-proteomics contract but build accepted it
Validator reports clean with cache-only OLS; PRIDE and MS accessions were resolved live in OLS4
Collision energy 25 NCE is from the RAW embedded method and scan headers; PRIDE protocol says 28% (conflict, raw preferred)
Phenotype mapping D3 = wild type / D3w = wrinkly remains an inference: the 'w' could mean wildtype, D3inter is unexplained, and the paper full text is unreachable

Fixed carbamidomethyl, 4.5/20 ppm tolerances and 2 missed cleavages come only from the PRIDE protocol; mqpar.xml is not deposited (summary.txt confirms only variable modifications and Trypsin/P, 2 missed cleavages)
The only date in the RAW headers (2016-11-28, tune file 20161129) is not a per-run acquisition timestamp; acquisition date not annotated
Acquisition order is confounded with phenotype (A-D wild type run before E-I wrinkly)
RAW method scan ranges (MS1 300-1750, MS2 200-2000) differ from the protocol (350-1500); not annotated
